summary: A Reigns-style, swipe-based survival game that teaches 7-12 year olds the complex engineering trade-offs of running an extraterrestrial outpost through intuitive resource management.
details:
Overview
Our solution reimagines the complexities of extraterrestrial outpost management into a highly engaging, browser-based survival game tailored specifically for children ages 7–12. Inspired by the critically acclaimed Reigns-style gameplay, the application simplifies the daunting task of running a lunar or Martian base into an accessible, binary-choice mechanics system that teaches fundamental engineering trade-offs through play. Rather than overwhelming young players with dense dashboards, spreadsheets, and intricate data tracking, the game condenses critical base operations into a fluid, intuitive swipe-style interface.

How It Works
Players step into the role of Outpost Commander and are presented with a continuous deck of scenario cards based on real-world space exploration challenges. Each choice directly impacts three core survival resources: Power, Oxygen, and Morale. The game provides immediate visual feedback on how a single decision can deplete one resource while replenishing another, naturally introducing young minds to the delicate balance of mission resource management.

Science & Data Integration
To ensure the game is scientifically grounded, the scenario cards integrate real-world concepts derived from actual NASA mission data. For example, events involving solar array dust coverage reflect the power degradation challenges faced by Mars landers like InSight, forcing players to weigh the cost of cleaning panels against losing capacity. Scenarios requiring players to extract water from Martian regolith introduce In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU), demonstrating the high energy costs of mining local materials.
